mostWorthwhile.text: Making hydroxyl and then water on a grain was the strongest sequence: it showed both the intermediate and the grain’s role in helping reactions occur.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining water ice with mixed dust to make ice-mantled dust felt somewhat repetitive after water ice was already on grains.

surprise.text: Water ice can form before planets exist, and some interstellar water can survive solar-system formation.

arbitrary.text: The ice-and-dust combination had a clear goal, but why adding mixed dust produced mantles was less clear than the preceding surface chemistry.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how this cold cloud develops into a planetary system, especially what happens to its ice.
